doc.brief: The QWizardPage class is the base class for wizard pages.
doc.index_brief: The base class for wizard pages

QPixmap pixmap(QWizard::WizardPixmap whi.brief: Returns the pixmap set for role *which*.

QString buttonText(QWizard::WizardButton.brief: Returns the text on button *which* on this page.

QString subTitle() const.brief: This property holds the subtitle of the page

QString title() const.brief: This property holds the title of the page

QVariant field(const QString &name) cons.brief: Returns the value of the field called *name*.

QWizard * wizard() const.brief: Returns the wizard associated with this page, or `nullptr` if this page hasn't been inserted into a [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) yet.

QWizardPage(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a wizard page with the given *parent*.

bool isCommitPage() const.brief: Returns `true` if this page is a commit page; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isComplete() const.brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) to determine whether the **Next** or **Finish** button should be enabled or disabled.

bool isFinalPage() const.brief: This function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) to determine whether the **Finish** button should be shown for this page or not.

bool validatePage().brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard::validateCurrentPage](xref:qt:QWizard)() when the user clicks **Next** or **Finish** to perform some last-minute validation.

int nextId() const.brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard::nextId](xref:qt:QWizard)() to find out which page to show when the user clicks the **Next** button.

void cleanupPage().brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard::cleanupPage](xref:qt:QWizard)() when the user leaves the page by clicking **Back** (unless the [QWizard::IndependentPages](xref:qt:QWizard) option is set).

void completeChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the complete state of the page (i.e., the value of [isComplete](xref:qt:QWizardPage)()) changes.

void initializePage().brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard::initializePage](xref:qt:QWizard)() to prepare the page just before it is shown either as a result of [QWizard::restart](xref:qt:QWizard)() being called...

void registerField(const QString &name,.brief: Creates a field called *name* associated with the given *property* of the given *widget*.

void setButtonText(QWizard::WizardButton.brief: Sets the text on button *which* to be *text* on this page.

void setCommitPage(bool commitPage).brief: Sets this page to be a commit page if *commitPage* is true; otherwise, sets it to be a normal page.

void setField(const QString &name, const.brief: Sets the value of the field called *name* to *value*.

void setFinalPage(bool finalPage).brief: Explicitly sets this page to be final if *finalPage* is true.

void setPixmap(QWizard::WizardPixmap whi.brief: Sets the pixmap for role *which* to *pixmap*.

void setSubTitle(const QString &subTitle.brief: This property holds the subtitle of the page

void setTitle(const QString &title).brief: This property holds the title of the page
